summarization: This smartphone UI screen appears to be part of an educational or informational app. The main content of the screen is a text block explaining the concept of "remarketing" or "retargeting," which is described humorously as "wining and dining" after a visit. The text suggests that even if users are not familiar with the term, they have likely experienced remarketing before. At the bottom of the screen, there is a prompt that says, "See if you can spot it," likely encouraging users to identify examples of remarketing. The screen also includes standard navigation elements such as a home icon, a progress bar, and sharing options.
